policies.name: Editorial Integrity & Hospitality Objectivity Policy
policies.purpose: Ensures all operational guides, benchmarks, and architectural analyses reflect unbiased, merchant-first hospitality engineering standards.
standards: Zero paid sponsorship or third-party editorial interference
All technical claims must be grounded in production benchmarks or verifiable code
Clear separation between architectural documentation and commercial positioning
policies.enforcementMechanism: Mandatory peer review by at least one independent technical reviewer before public release.

policies.name: Multi-Role Peer Review Policy
policies.purpose: Mandates multi-discipline peer review across technical, regulatory, and operational criteria prior to publication.
standards: Technical Review: Validation of offline caching, network sockets, and API schemas
Legal/Regulatory Review: Verification of payment compliance, GST invoicing, and data security
Editorial Review: Assessment of step-by-step clarity, tone, and readability
policies.enforcementMechanism: Automated CI build failure if published content lacks verified reviewer IDs.

policies.name: Content Lifecycle & Quarterly Audit Policy
policies.purpose: Prevents content decay by establishing maximum age thresholds and mandatory re-audits.
standards: Competitor comparison tables must be audited at least once every 90 days
Technical API documentation must be re-verified with every major and minor platform release
Timestamp transparency: Explicitly exposing publishedAt and updatedAt in UI and schema
policies.enforcementMechanism: Automated decay alerts flagged by ContentFreshnessEngine.

policies.name: Empirical Verification & Fact-Checking Policy
policies.purpose: Guarantees the statistical integrity of margin calculations, commission math, and performance claims.
standards: Margin calculations must publish all underlying cost formulas and assumptions
Commission rates cited for food delivery aggregators must reflect public merchant agreements
Hardware and network latency claims must be benchmarked on standard Android/iOS devices
policies.enforcementMechanism: Reviewer signoff on calculation spreadsheets and benchmark reproduction.

policies.name: Transparent Corrections & Retractions Policy
policies.purpose: Provides public correction logs whenever substantive technical or financial errors are identified.
standards: Corrections must include an explicit editor notice stating the correction date and prior claim
Semantic version bump for modified technical documentation
Public changelog entries for breaking API changes or corrected financial estimates
policies.enforcementMechanism: Public changelog logging and semantic version tracking.

policies.name: Responsible AI & Automated Tooling Policy
policies.purpose: Governs the acceptable use of algorithmic automation and artificial intelligence in content production.
standards: Zero unreviewed or purely synthetic AI-generated articles permitted on the domain
All AI-assisted outlines or schema structures must be authored, validated, and signed by human experts
Prohibition of synthetic customer reviews, artificial ratings, or hallucinated benchmark data
policies.enforcementMechanism: Schema Engine zero-synthetic review gatekeeper and mandatory author attribution.
